title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Oil Filter Housing Drain, Retrofit Packaging
abstract: Closed pre-analysis of whether the drain nozzle retrofit could be embodied by line stations at a filter change rather than at a base visit, delegated to customer services once the tooling question was settled.

sections.objective: Establish whether the bayonet drain nozzle and closed shroud could be embodied by a line station during a routine filter element change, rather than being planned into a base visit.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and none blocking. The work itself is a two-hour task with the fan cowl open and needs no special skills, so a line station can do it. The drain hose with the bayonet fitting is not a standard line tool and would have to be issued with the kit or held at the station, which was the practical obstacle. The drain task text assumes the aircraft standard is known before the task starts, and a part-embodied fleet makes that assumption unsafe at a line station where the configuration record may not be to hand. The troubleshooting entry for the filter clog advisory refers to the fairing cleaning step and needed a small wording change. The engineering answer was yes, and the decision on kit distribution belonged to customer services.
sections.next_steps: Delegated to customer services for kit and tooling distribution. The task wording change was raised separately.

similarity_seeds: a retrofit that needs one tool the line station does not hold

tasks.title: Assess the task for line station embodiment
List the tooling not held at line stations

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin is per engine and both engines should be at the same standard so that the drain method is the same on each side; a line embodiment could easily do one and defer the other.
expected_findings.resolution: State in the kit instruction that both engines are embodied at the same visit.

expected_findings.rationale: The drain task branches on aircraft standard at step five. At a line station with no configuration record to hand, an engineer could follow the wrong branch and spill oil onto the fairing.
expected_findings.resolution: Add a physical identification step at the start of the task so the standard can be read from the housing.

expected_findings.rationale: The procedure refers to the fairing cleaning step in terms that assume the delivered drain arrangement.
expected_findings.resolution: Correct the wording at the next issue.

type_data.conclusion: Closed and delegated to customer services for kit and tooling distribution.
